name: STEPBible interlinear (TAHOT + TAGNT + TBESH + TBESG + TEHMC + TEGMC): sample (3John)

sample.note: A cut of the full pack, committed to git so a fresh clone has interlinear data. Book files are byte-identical to the full pack's; strongs.json and morph_codes.json keep only the entries these books use. The full pack ships as a release artifact (docs/UPDATES.md).

source.modifications: TSV columns parsed; mainline reading selected per word (NA27/28 for NT, Leningrad for OT); Hebrew slashed morphemes collapsed into a composite word form; primary Strong's extracted from brace-marked primary form; HTML stripped from lexicon long entries and truncated to 600 chars; morph codes keyed by exact compound string. Sample: restricted to 3John; lexicon and morph-code files cut to the entries those books use.
